description.narrative:
The purpose of the System Capacity Grant (SCG) project is to strengthen the capacity and resilience of Myanmar's education sector through improving education planning, financing, and coordination to create a more inclusive and equitable system. Key outcomes and related project activities of the SCG Project are:
Component 1: Developing and implementing the Joint Response Framework (JRF) 2025-2028 - Develop an inclusive, gender, and disability-sensitive Joint Response Framework (JRF) effectively and implemented to address key educational challenges and enhances strategic responses to emerging needs in education sector. - Establish a JRF M&E System to track the progress and effectiveness of aid investments and implemented with specific attention to gender equality and inclusion of children with disabilities. - Provide support to M&E professionals to effectively use the JRF MEL framework, promoted for knowledge-sharing, and provided ongoing support. - Conduct JRF and Education Cluster midterm and endline evaluation to promote learning and enhance accountability.
Component 2: Strengthen sector coordination and resource mobilization - Strengthen governance structures through the education sector coordination framework and stakeholder engagement. - Establish and strengthen Technical Working Groups dedicated to specific thematic areas such as gender and disability inclusion, teacher professional development and JRF M&E. - Develop and implement localized resource mobilization strategies to align with Myanmar’s education needs.
Component 3: Evidence-based Decision Making in Strategic Policy and Program Development - Conduct comprehensive situational analyses and thematic studies to provide an in-depth overview of the state of education in Myanmar with broad participation of education sector groups and members to identify gaps and priority interventions. - Conduct various educational thematic analyses to fill evidence gaps, including disabilities inclusion and gender disparity.
